d.ko: Build your dream ship! From a racing yacht to a massive battleship, test if it actually floats. Sail it, watch it sink, or accidentally invent a submarine. Share your creations on Steam Workshop, then put them to the test when multiplayer battles and racing arrives November 19!
d.en: Build your dream ship! From a racing yacht to a massive battleship, test if it actually floats. Sail it, watch it sink, or accidentally invent a submarine. Share your creations on Steam Workshop, then put them to the test when multiplayer battles and racing arrives November 19!
d.zh: 《造船师》是一款专注于船舶设计乐趣的自由创作游戏。自由塑造船体，搭配丰富组件，无需复杂的3D建模技巧，也没有固定蓝图与标准答案。从简单的渔船、帆船，到铁甲舰与无畏舰！把脑海中的船一点点做出来。没有多余的目标，只留下造船本身的乐趣。1-8人联机战斗将于11月19日上线！
